premises.text: Aviation must decarbonize to meet net-zero goals, and electric flight starting from light aircraft is the path
premises.evidence_span: we are convinced aviation will be electric

premises.text: Hydrogen balances energy efficiency and aircraft range/speed/payload better than batteries or SAF for their aircraft
premises.evidence_span: hydrogen in the middle has good enough energy efficiency and a good enough aircraft performance

premises.text: Demonstrated hydrogen-to-propeller powertrain integrated into an aircraft ready for test flight
premises.evidence_span: an 85 kilowatt powertrain from hydrogen tanks to a propeller

premises.text: Scalable powertrain architecture enables a 6–8 passenger pressurized business jet matching existing missions without direct emissions
premises.evidence_span: comparable performance without the direct emissions

premises.text: Aircraft integration includes tank placement and thermal management around the powertrain
premises.evidence_span: how to integrate the tanks below the cabin of an aircraft, and how to integrate thermal management system

premises.text: Working with European airports to ready hydrogen supply for the jet
premises.evidence_span: we're working with 50 of them to bring hydrogen for our aircraft

value.text: Business aviation missions with comparable performance and without direct emissions
value.evidence_span: comparable performance without the direct emissions

secondary_value.text: Potential large-scale CO2 reduction contribution as platforms scale
